pokemon-tcg-rulebook.title: Pokémon Trading Card Game Rulebook (The Pokémon Company International)
pokemon-tcg-rulebook.note: Deck construction and setup: 60-card deck, 7-card opening hand, 6 prize cards, 5 bench spots, at most 4 cards with the same name except basic Energy.

in-repo-fixture.title: games/boardgame/tests/fixtures/pokemon-sample.json
in-repo-fixture.note: Hand-written sample fixture that encodes the same 60/7/6/5 contract; not official card text or artwork.

in-repo-engine.title: games/boardgame/app/cardgame.js RULES_META
in-repo-engine.note: The playable page and the online server both use these values.

art-guide.title: games/ART-GUIDE.md
art-guide.note: Physical card size 63×88mm on 300gsm stock; paper fiber and edge wear must read as real material.

rules.winCondition: Take all 6 prize cards, or the opponent has no Pokémon left in play.

deckCount.basis: Official deck construction requires exactly 60 cards.

openingHand.basis: Each player draws 7 cards during setup.

prizeCards.basis: Each player sets 6 prize cards face down; taking the last one wins.

benchSize.basis: Each player may have up to 5 Benched Pokémon.

maxCopiesPerName.basis: A deck may contain at most 4 cards with the same name; basic Energy is exempt.

cardBack.description: Original mountain-and-leaf emblem in deep teal and warm gold; no brand marks.

deviations.detail: The in-repo sample keeps 20 trainer HP and 2 breakthrough damage as a demo scoring layer. Official TCG has no trainer HP and ends on prize cards; the sample also ends when the last prize is taken.
No manual switch action; when the Active is Knocked Out the first Benched Basic is promoted automatically.
The engine reuses a 10-creature pool (4 copies each = 40) plus 20 basic Energy to reach 60 cards. Card names and art are original, not real Pokémon.
